payload.title: Swift sync resilience: reconnect resubscribe + injectable schema descriptor/identity + resilient fetch
payload.description: Shipped in 0.1.1 (PR #5). FrickSyncSocket replays active subscriptions after reconnect and buffers pre-open frames (FIFO behind Hello); FrickClient accepts full app schema identity (schemaId/schemaRevision/schemaHash) + injected FrickSchemaDescriptor threaded into Hello/caps/HTTP guards/packed Snapshot+Delta decode; fetchObjects decodes rows individually and skips malformed rows (RCRM-136). Reconnect backoff exponent capped to avoid Int overflow.
